name: Dayo Ferreira
role: Gray-market compound supplier and entertainment-circuit broker, Milwaukee–Chicago corridor
description: A slim Nigerian-Brazilian man in early forties with cedar-brown skin, a low fade, and a matte-black jacket that costs more than the Velvet Tine's PA system. He has been supplying Fenris and similar acts in the Milwaukee–Chicago corridor for nearly a decade. His business model sits at the legal-gray intersection of entertainment, hospitality, and controlled-substance supply — what some circuits call a 'provider,' what the law would call a pimp and a dealer, what his clients call 'Dayo.' He speaks very little. The goods do the talking. He arrives with a cold-box of compounds and company, sets it on the table, opens it, and waits. The gesture is the whole thing. He is not a villain. He exists in an economic ecosystem that produces him, and he is very good at existing in it. His composure when Koss's crew breaks through the door is the composure of a man who has done the math on exactly how often this happens in his line of work — the math was optimistic by one incident.
narrative_function: The mechanism by which Faith and the other party guests arrive at the Velvet Tine. His shooting provides Mona's cover (she hides under his unconscious body). His survival provides a future story hook.

psychology.secret: He has been shot before. Not like this.
psychology.core_wound: He has made his peace with the life he lives by deciding never to need it to be different.
psychology.desire: Not to need anything from anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, sparse. He selects words with the deliberation of someone who has learned that talking too much is a liability.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and complete. No filler. Sentences arrive finished.
speech_patterns.subtext: Almost everything. Dayo communicates in implication.
speech_patterns.under_pressure: Gets quieter. Does not perform fear.
speech_patterns.intimacy_register: Does not exist in observable form.

physical_description.build: Slim, controlled. The posture of someone who has spent time in environments where physical confidence is currency.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Whether there is anything concealed is deliberately ambiguous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economy of motion. Very still when not moving. Moves purposefully when he does.

story_hooks: His crew was targeted. Someone who knew his route tipped Koss. He will want to know who.
He survives. He regains consciousness before the paramedics leave. His first question to Mona when he can speak: 'Who was the one they couldn't find?'

relationships.name: Fenris
relationships.notes: Has supplied the band for approximately four years. Professional relationship only.

relationships.name: Faith Larson
relationships.notes: Brought her to the Tine. Does not know what she is.
